name: Tomoshibi
source:
A story about suffocation and freedom.
Kujou Keiho, a failure of the demon house and the Kujo family, has been living in a small room since childhood.
Then, one day, a strange young man comes to her room...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5823]official site[/url]]
